notes: All URLs in 'sources' were fetched on 2026-11-24 with curl (desktop Chrome User-Agent) from a US host; each endpoint carries a 'check' string with what came back. Key findings: (1) The Little Compton town site (Revize) has no RSS, Atom or sitemap; its only machine-readable output is the public Google Calendar ICS. Council/board agendas and minutes are PDFs on the RI Secretary of State Open Meetings portal, which does have RSS: /RSSFeed/Rss?feedType=1&entityID=0&...&PublicBodies=<name> (upcoming, filtered by name), feedType=9&entityID=<id> (recently filed minutes for one body), feedType=7&entityID=<id> (upcoming for one body). Entity IDs are listed in the notes of the Open Meetings sources; Little Compton bodies are 1819-1845, Tiverton bodies 3501-3550 plus North Tiverton Fire District 2392. Avoid feedType=3 (statewide archive, >100 MB). (2) Tiverton (CivicPlus) has full RSS and iCal; its AgendaCenter is empty and agendas/minutes are on ClerkBase (clerkshq.com/tiverton-ri) and the SOS portal. (3) Westport MA (Revize) has /rss.xml without item dates; agendas/minutes are PDFs on per-board pages; meeting video is on two YouTube channels. (4) EastBayRI town sections share one Creative Circle feed pattern (<town>/category/news/browse.rss) and mix in region-wide stories. (5) Gannett papers (Newport Daily News, Providence Journal, Herald News, Standard-Times) and RI state agency sites (dem/health/riema.ri.gov) block automated clients, so they are leads only. (6) Several WordPress/Newspack hosts (whatsupnewp.com, newbedfordlight.org, thepublicsradio.org, littlecompton.org) rate-limit quickly with HTTP 429: crawl slowly. (7) Many small-organisation feeds exist but are dormant (Historical Society posts 2023, Sakonnet Preservation 2020, LCACT 2024, school blog 2023, Four Corners Arts events feed 2021, Farmcoast 2019); see 'has_live_feed'. Paywall values for EastBayRI and the Globe are 'metered' based on visible subscriber/day-pass prompts; exact meters were not tested. Coverage levels (dedicated/regular/occasional) for regional outlets are judgments, not measured. Scope was widened mid-task to 'Open Local' (food-drink, farm-market, arts-culture, museum, tourism, business types).
